name: C-14A stun grenade
description: The C-14A stun grenade was a small grenade with the aim of incapacitating rather than killing targets. It was manufactured by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc. It had a metallic sphere covered in beam splitters and a clublike handle. The grenade held energy in optic capacitors that would discharge when it was used. The blast would hit the beam splitters and cover the area in stunning energy.
